findings.title: Nil TopicUser crash and missing metadata update in TopicsController#unsubscribe
findings.body: `TopicsController#unsubscribe` fetches the user's topic state with `tu = TopicUser.find_by(user_id: current_user.id, topic_id: params[:topic_id])` and immediately accesses `tu.notification_level`. If no `topic_users` row exists for the user and topic (for example, if the user visits the unsubscribe URL before interacting with the topic or clicks a link from a forwarded email), `tu` is `nil` and the action raises `NoMethodError`. Additionally, mutating `tu.notification_level` and calling `tu.save!` directly instead of using `TopicUser.change` fails to set `notifications_changed_at` and `notifications_reason_id` (and skips MessageBus publication); if `notifications_reason_id` was `nil`, `TopicUser.update_last_read` and `TopicUser.auto_track` will treat the level as unset and automatically switch the topic back to `tracking` when the user views or interacts with it.

findings.title: GET unsubscribe endpoint is non-idempotent and mutates state on page load
findings.body: `GET /t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe` mutates the user's notification level directly inside the `GET` handler, and the mutation is non-idempotent: if the user's level is `watching` or `tracking`, the first `GET` lowers it to `regular`, while refreshing the page (or a browser prefetch/prerender) issues a second `GET` that sees `regular` and lowers it again to `muted`. Conversely, if a user navigates to `/t/:slug/:id/unsubscribe` via a client-side Ember transition where `PreloadStore` is empty, `topic-unsubscribe.js.es6` calls `PostStream.loadTopicView(params.id)` (which requests `GET /t/:id.json`, routed to `TopicsController#show`), so the UI displays the unsubscribed message without ever invoking `TopicsController#unsubscribe`.

findings.title: MessageBuilder raises MissingInterpolationArgument when add_unsubscribe_link is used without unsubscribe_url
findings.body: The `unsubscribe_link` locale string in `config/locales/server.en.yml` now interpolates `%{unsubscribe_url}`, which `Email::MessageBuilder` passes to `I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args)` in both `html_part` (line 67) and `body` (line 90) whenever `@opts[:add_unsubscribe_link]` is truthy. Unlike `user_preferences_url`, `unsubscribe_url` is not given a default in `@template_args` or guarded by its presence, so any caller passing `add_unsubscribe_link: true` without an `unsubscribe_url` option will raise `I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument`.

findings.title: No controller or model specs for topic unsubscribe functionality
findings.body: The PR adds `TopicsController#unsubscribe`, `Topic#unsubscribe_url`, and the new `/t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe` and `/t/:topic_id/unsubscribe` routes, but only updates a single fixture argument in `spec/components/email/message_builder_spec.rb`. There are no specs covering `TopicsController#unsubscribe` (authentication, slug redirects, notification level transitions, or missing `TopicUser` records) or verifying that `unsubscribe_url` is rendered into notification emails.
